defects.quote: WHEN a booking is marked as a no-show, the system SHALL send the member who held it a text
defects.description: Telling the member by text message contradicts the brief, which says Rallybook contacts people by email only and never sends text messages.
"Promptly" has no measure, so nobody can check whether removing a mark updates the count soon enough; the rule needs a stated time (or to say the count shows the change on the next view).
